task: Session records currently store the user id, the token hash, an absolute expiry, and a last-seen time. Extend login to accept the OAuth client id and persist it on the new session, and change refresh so it keeps that user and client while minting a new session id, bearer token, and absolute expiry. Share one mint helper between login and refresh. Rename Session.LastSeen to TouchedAt and set it from the caller-supplied time on both paths. Update the comments and the unit tests so a refresh covers an unchanged user and client and an expiry that moves forward.
